column1: # FLvibed speaker name colours (owned here; design: subtitles\docs\DISPLAY_PLAN.md "Speaker colours", 21 Oct 2026).
# tier: main = the main cast, each its own authored colour (the character's look / faction / role); side = named people
# with small parts, each its own colour in the family's hue range; story = the story's other speakers (stations,
# ships, wings, crowds): the family's light tint, or a hostile red. stance: friendly / neutral / hostile, then
# per-mission exceptions (m04:hostile); a hostile stance adds the red triangle before the name, and a story speaker
# hostile only in that mission falls back to the hostile red. Speakers not listed (open-world chatter): the HUD's
# relation colours. Trent is the player's amber in code. Side / story colours are fitted by
# subtitles\tools\speaker_colors.py (run it after changing a row); debug `colors` checks the table in game.
